newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean unemployment up slightly in Feb-April.
newsitem.headline: Chilean unemployment up slightly in Feb-April.

text.p: Unemployment in Chile rose a notch to six percent in the February-to-April quarter from 5.8 percent in the first three months of the year, the National Statistics Institute reported.
Joblessness was off slightly, 0.1 percentage point, compared with the February-to-April quarter of 1996, the institute reported.
Overall hourly wages climbed 9.4 percent in April over the same month last year, and 0.3 percent over March, the institute said.
Youth unemployment continued to run much higher than the overall figure, at 14.3 percent, up from 14.0 percent in the February-to-April quarter of 1996, the institute said.
